# discord_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists the webhooks of every channel in a server. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_webhooks" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) The webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the webhook posts to.
- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `name` (String) Webhook name.
- `type` (String) Webhook type: `incoming`, `channel_follower`, `application`.
